$comment: Plan W11.P14: the offline package for yeshivot and schools without internet (or behind NetFree): what goes on the drive, where it comes from and its licence. `node scripts/edu-offline-pack.mjs` builds it from local files only (it downloads nothing) and writes SHA256SUMS. Every model entry names its id in models/registry.json, and only `allowed` models go in.

components.note: MSIX for Intune / the Microsoft Store; the Tauri build gives .msi and an NSIS -setup.exe today (MSIX packaging is owed: W11.M13).
Inside the app already; copied to the drive too, so IT can check it.
Keyword search in Hebrew needs no model; this one adds search by meaning.

tts.he: ההקראה משתמשת בקולות של מערכת ההפעלה. ב-Windows מתקינים את חבילת השפה העברית עם הקול (הגדרות ← זמן ושפה ← שפה ← עברית ← דיבור). מודלי ההקראה העבריים הפתוחים ברישיון לא מסחרי, ולכן אינם בחבילה.
tts.en: Read aloud uses the system's voices. On Windows, install the Hebrew language pack with its voice. The open Hebrew TTS models are non-commercial (models/registry.json: forbidden), so none is on the drive.
